gaps_identified.description: Excluded-by-allowlist scenarios do NOT get lifecycle records. runner.py line 584 iterates only ctx.planning.ready_scenarios.
gaps_identified.impact: Splitter and Optimizer have no lifecycle record. dropped_count could be non-zero if someone removes taskcards.
gaps_identified.fix: Add lifecycle records for blocked scenarios before generation loop.

gaps_identified.description: No durable backlog entries for PDF excluded scenarios. workspace/backlog/ does not exist.
gaps_identified.impact: Splitter and Optimizer are only tracked via taskcards, not in structured backlog with root cause, priority, and cross-links.
gaps_identified.fix: Create backlog entries for excluded scenarios.

gaps_identified.description: PR body excluded_scenarios parameter never populated. build_pr() called without it at publisher.py:214 and __main__.py:645.
gaps_identified.impact: Every PR body says 'Excluded Scenarios: None' even when scenarios are blocked.
gaps_identified.fix: Read blocked-scenarios.json and pass excluded scenarios to build_pr().

gaps_identified.description: release_status.py does not track backlog/excluded/failed counts.
gaps_identified.impact: Release status hides that scenarios are pending or blocked.
gaps_identified.fix: Add backlog_count, excluded_count, blocked_scenarios fields to release status.

gaps_identified.description: Reviewer returns only pass/fail boolean. No per-example structured feedback. No feedback-driven repair loop.
gaps_identified.impact: Reviewer failures cannot drive automatic regeneration. Backlog entry says 'Address reviewer feedback' with no specifics.
gaps_identified.fix: Future: Extract per-example findings from reviewer output. Feed into repair prompt.

gaps_identified.description: No cross-run learning. Backlog entries exist per-run but previous failure patterns are not fed into next run's prompt.
gaps_identified.impact: Same failures may repeat across runs.
gaps_identified.fix: Future: Read family backlog before generation; add failure patterns to system prompt.
